A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 121: Read the email. Then write what Angela actually said to Delia.

Bài 121: Đọc email. Rồi viết chính xác những gì Angela đã nói với Delia.

Exercise 122: A year after his interview at an art college, Alex tells his friend Charlie about it. Complete Alex’s answers.

Bài 122: Một năm sau buổi phỏng vấn vào trường mỹ thuật, Alex kể lại cho bạn là Charlie. Hoàn thành câu trả lời của Alex.

Exercise 123: Look back at your answers to Exercise 116. Complete the article which the journalist wrote a month after the interview with Wilma.

Bài 123: Xem lại đáp án Bài 116. Hoàn thành bài báo nhà báo viết một tháng sau buổi phỏng vấn Wilma.

Exercise 124: John had a row with his girlfriend, Julie. His friend Mark talked to Julie for John. Complete the conversation Mark had later with John.

Bài 124: John cãi nhau với bạn gái Julie. Bạn anh là Mark nói chuyện với Julie giúp John. Hoàn thành cuộc trò chuyện sau đó giữa Mark và John.

Exercise 125: You’ve just arrived at the Great Bay Hotel. It’s not the same as your travel agent told you it would be. Look at your travel agent’s website and complete your email to the travel agent.

Bài 125: Bạn vừa đến khách sạn Great Bay. Nó không giống như đại lý du lịch đã nói. Xem trang web của đại lý và hoàn thành email gửi họ.

Exercise 126: Anna has just met the singer Aidan Flanagan. She is telling Ian about the meeting. Now write exactly what Anna and Aidan said.

Bài 126: Anna vừa gặp ca sĩ Aidan Flanagan. Cô đang kể cho Ian nghe. Giờ viết chính xác những gì Anna và Aidan đã nói.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 47–50 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 47–50 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: (Delia: She told me she was still living with her parents.) Angela: ‘___ with my parents.’
mcq.full: (Delia: She told me she was still living with her parents.) Angela: ‘I’m still living with my parents.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: Cô ấy nói vẫn đang sống với bố mẹ.) Angela: ‘Tớ vẫn đang sống với bố mẹ.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was living → am living.
mcq.key: (Delia: She told me she was still living with her parents.) Angela: ‘___ with my parents.’|I’m still living

mcq.question: (Delia: … but she wanted to move out.) Angela: ‘… but I ___ to move out.’
mcq.full: (Delia: … but she wanted to move out.) Angela: ‘… but I want to move out.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: … nhưng cô ấy muốn dọn ra ở riêng.) Angela: ‘… nhưng tớ muốn dọn ra ở riêng.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wanted → want.
mcq.key: (Delia: … but she wanted to move out.) Angela: ‘… but I ___ to move out.’|want

mcq.question: (Delia: She explained that her sister had found a flat they could share.) Angela: ‘My sister ___ a flat we can share.’
mcq.full: (Delia: She explained that her sister had found a flat they could share.) Angela: ‘My sister has found a flat we can share.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: Cô ấy giải thích chị gái đã tìm được căn hộ hai người có thể ở chung.) Angela: ‘Chị tớ đã tìm được căn hộ hai chị em có thể ở chung.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: had found → has found.
mcq.key: (Delia: She explained that her sister had found a flat they could share.) Angela: ‘My sister ___ a flat we can share.’|has found

mcq.question: (Delia: … and they’d looked round it the week before.) Angela: ‘… and we looked round it ___.’
mcq.full: (Delia: … and they’d looked round it the week before.) Angela: ‘… and we looked round it last week.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: … và họ đã đi xem tuần trước đó.) Angela: ‘… và bọn tớ đã đi xem tuần trước.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: the week before → last week.
mcq.key: (Delia: … and they’d looked round it the week before.) Angela: ‘… and we looked round it ___.’|last week

mcq.question: (Delia: It had just been decorated.) Angela: ‘It ___ just ___.’
mcq.full: (Delia: It had just been decorated.) Angela: ‘It has just been decorated.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: Căn hộ vừa được trang trí lại.) Angela: ‘Căn hộ vừa được trang trí lại.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: had been done → has been done.
mcq.key: (Delia: It had just been decorated.) Angela: ‘It ___ just ___.’|has … been decorated

mcq.question: (Delia: … because she was working part-time and she didn’t earn much money …) Angela: ‘… because ___ part-time and I don’t earn much money …’
mcq.full: (Delia: … because she was working part-time and she didn’t earn much money …) Angela: ‘… because I’m working part-time and I don’t earn much money …’
mcq.vi: (Delia: … vì cô ấy đang làm bán thời gian và không kiếm được nhiều tiền …) Angela: ‘… vì tớ đang làm bán thời gian và không kiếm được nhiều tiền …’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was working → am working.
mcq.key: (Delia: … because she was working part-time and she didn’t earn much money …) Angela: ‘… because ___ part-time and I don’t earn much money …’|I’m working

mcq.question: (Delia: … she hadn’t saved enough for the deposit.) Angela: ‘I ___ enough for the deposit.’
mcq.full: (Delia: … she hadn’t saved enough for the deposit.) Angela: ‘I haven’t saved enough for the deposit.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: … cô ấy chưa tiết kiệm đủ tiền đặt cọc.) Angela: ‘Tớ chưa tiết kiệm đủ tiền đặt cọc.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hadn’t saved → haven’t saved.
mcq.key: (Delia: … she hadn’t saved enough for the deposit.) Angela: ‘I ___ enough for the deposit.’|haven’t saved

mcq.question: (Delia: She said she was going to get a new job.) Angela: ‘___ to get a new job.’
mcq.full: (Delia: She said she was going to get a new job.) Angela: ‘I’m going to get a new job.’
mcq.vi: (Delia: Cô ấy nói sẽ tìm việc mới.) Angela: ‘Tớ sẽ tìm việc mới.’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was going to → am going to.
mcq.key: (Delia: She said she was going to get a new job.) Angela: ‘___ to get a new job.’|I’m going

mcq.question: (Delia: She was being interviewed the next day …) Angela: ‘I’m being interviewed ___ …’
mcq.full: (Delia: She was being interviewed the next day …) Angela: ‘I’m being interviewed tomorrow …’
mcq.vi: (Delia: Hôm sau cô ấy có buổi phỏng vấn …) Angela: ‘Ngày mai tớ có buổi phỏng vấn …’
mcq.expl:
Reported → direct speech: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done or did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Tường thuật → lời nói trực tiếp: was / were → am / is / are; had done → have done hoặc did; could → can; the week before → last week; the next day → tomorrow; she / they → I / we.
Điểm ngữ pháp: the next day → tomorrow.
mcq.key: (Delia: She was being interviewed the next day …) Angela: ‘I’m being interviewed ___ …’|tomorrow

mcq.question: Well, the interviewer started by asking me when I ___ school.
mcq.full: Well, the interviewer started by asking me when I’d left school.
mcq.vi: Ừ, người phỏng vấn bắt đầu bằng việc hỏi tớ đã rời trường khi nào.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had + V3.
mcq.key: Well, the interviewer started by asking me when I ___ school.|’d left

mcq.question: And then he wanted to know what I ___ since then.
mcq.full: And then he wanted to know what I’d done since then.
mcq.vi: Rồi ông ấy muốn biết từ đó tớ đã làm gì.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have done → had done.
mcq.key: And then he wanted to know what I ___ since then.|’d done

mcq.question: I told him I ___ several jobs.
mcq.full: I told him I’d had several jobs.
mcq.vi: Tớ kể là tớ đã làm vài công việc.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had had.
mcq.key: I told him I ___ several jobs.|’d had

mcq.question: First I ___ in a cafe for about a year.
mcq.full: First I’d worked in a cafe for about a year.
mcq.vi: Đầu tiên tớ đã làm ở quán cà phê khoảng một năm.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had worked.
mcq.key: First I ___ in a cafe for about a year.|’d worked

mcq.question: … because I ___ to save a lot of money for travelling.
mcq.full: … because I’d needed to save a lot of money for travelling.
mcq.vi: … vì tớ cần tiết kiệm nhiều tiền để đi du lịch.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had needed.
mcq.key: … because I ___ to save a lot of money for travelling.|’d needed

mcq.question: Of course he asked me where I ___ to go.
mcq.full: Of course he asked me where I’d wanted to go.
mcq.vi: Tất nhiên ông ấy hỏi tớ đã muốn đi đâu.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had wanted.
mcq.key: Of course he asked me where I ___ to go.|’d wanted

mcq.question: When I told him, he asked whether I ___ all those places.
mcq.full: When I told him, he asked whether I’d visited all those places.
mcq.vi: Khi tớ kể, ông ấy hỏi tớ đã đến hết những nơi đó chưa.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had visited.
mcq.key: When I told him, he asked whether I ___ all those places.|’d visited

mcq.question: I explained to him that I ___ to Brazil and Peru.
mcq.full: I explained to him that I’d been to Brazil and Peru.
mcq.vi: Tớ giải thích là tớ đã đến Brazil và Peru.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had been.
mcq.key: I explained to him that I ___ to Brazil and Peru.|’d been

mcq.question: … and I ___ some months in Turkey.
mcq.full: … and I’d spent some months in Turkey.
mcq.vi: … và tớ đã ở Thổ Nhĩ Kỳ vài tháng.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had spent.
mcq.key: … and I ___ some months in Turkey.|’d spent

mcq.question: He told me I ___ very lucky.
mcq.full: He told me I’d been very lucky.
mcq.vi: Ông ấy nói tớ đã rất may mắn.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had been.
mcq.key: He told me I ___ very lucky.|’d been

mcq.question: Then he asked if I ___ some work to show him.
mcq.full: Then he asked if I’d brought some work to show him.
mcq.vi: Rồi ông ấy hỏi tớ có mang tác phẩm nào cho ông xem không.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had brought.
mcq.key: Then he asked if I ___ some work to show him.|’d brought

mcq.question: He asked me when I ___ interested in painting and drawing.
mcq.full: He asked me when I’d become interested in painting and drawing.
mcq.vi: Ông ấy hỏi tớ bắt đầu thích hội họa và vẽ từ khi nào.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Lùi thì → had become.
mcq.key: He asked me when I ___ interested in painting and drawing.|’d become

mcq.question: I said that I ___ I always ___.
mcq.full: I said that I thought I always had been.
mcq.vi: Tớ nói là tớ nghĩ tớ luôn như vậy.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: think → thought; have been → had been.
mcq.key: I said that I ___ I always ___.|thought … had been

mcq.question: Oh, yes, and he told me my work ___ very good.
mcq.full: Oh, yes, and he told me my work was very good.
mcq.vi: À, và ông ấy nói tác phẩm của tớ rất tốt.
mcq.expl:
In reported speech the verb usually moves back: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Trong câu tường thuật động từ thường lùi thì: did / have done → had done; think → thought; is → was.
Điểm ngữ pháp: is → was.
mcq.key: Oh, yes, and he told me my work ___ very good.|was

mcq.question: First of all I asked Wilma how long she ___ here.
mcq.full: First of all I asked Wilma how long she was going to be here.
mcq.vi: Trước hết tôi hỏi Wilma cô sẽ ở đây bao lâu.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: are you going to be → she was going to be.
mcq.key: First of all I asked Wilma how long she ___ here.|was going to be

mcq.question: She told me it ___ her first visit to the U.K.
mcq.full: She told me it wasn’t her first visit to the U.K.
mcq.vi: Cô nói đây không phải lần đầu cô đến Anh.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: isn’t → wasn’t.
mcq.key: She told me it ___ her first visit to the U.K.|wasn’t

mcq.question: … because she ___ here five years before, for a holiday.
mcq.full: … because she’d come here five years before, for a holiday.
mcq.vi: … vì năm năm trước cô đã đến đây nghỉ.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: came → had come.
mcq.key: … because she ___ here five years before, for a holiday.|’d come

mcq.question: The pop singer then told me that she ___ a tour.
mcq.full: The pop singer then told me that she was doing a tour.
mcq.vi: Rồi nữ ca sĩ nói cô đang lưu diễn.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: am doing → was doing.
mcq.key: The pop singer then told me that she ___ a tour.|was doing

mcq.question: When I asked her how many cities she ___, she thought about twenty.
mcq.full: When I asked her how many cities she was going to visit, she thought about twenty.
mcq.vi: Khi tôi hỏi cô sẽ đến bao nhiêu thành phố, cô nghĩ khoảng hai mươi.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: am going to → was going to.
mcq.key: When I asked her how many cities she ___, she thought about twenty.|was going to visit

mcq.question: She said she ___ to have a holiday after the tour.
mcq.full: She said she wanted to have a holiday after the tour.
mcq.vi: Cô nói cô muốn đi nghỉ sau tour.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: want → wanted.
mcq.key: She said she ___ to have a holiday after the tour.|wanted

mcq.question: When I asked her whether she ___ a message for her fans …
mcq.full: When I asked her whether she had a message for her fans …
mcq.vi: Khi tôi hỏi cô có lời nhắn nào cho người hâm mộ không …
mcq.expl:
Reported speech after said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Câu tường thuật sau said / told / asked: is → was, came → had come, am doing → was doing, am going to → was going to, want → wanted, have → had; told somebody to do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have → had.
mcq.key: When I asked her whether she ___ a message for her fans …|had

mcq.question: … she told them ___ to the concerts and have a wild time.
mcq.full: … she told them to come to the concerts and have a wild time.
